title: A clearer journey, from the first choice.
intro: Rihla is a platform for booking intercity bus trips in Egypt. Choose your station, departure and seat, with your booking and ticket details in one place.
journeyTitle: From your starting point to your destination.
journeyText: Find a trip, reserve a seat and follow your ticket. Connected steps that keep your journey details together.
purposeText: We bring together the details you need before travelling: departure and arrival stations, schedules, fares and available seats. You can explore trips and stations before signing in.
purposeDetail: When you book, choose your seat and enter the passenger details. After payment, follow your booking status and open your ticket in your account once confirmed.
howText: A clear place for each step, so you can follow your journey without losing the details.

trip.title: Find your trip
trip.text: Choose your departure and arrival city or station and your travel date, then review the schedules and fares.

seat.title: Choose your seat
seat.text: See the bus layout, pick from the available seats and add passenger names and a contact number.

ticket.title: Follow your booking
ticket.text: Pay within the deadline shown and check the status in your account. Your ticket appears after payment and booking confirmation.

exploreTitle: A little more to know before you go.
stationsText: Browse stations by city and search for your station on the map.
faqsText: Read about booking, payment and tickets, and understand your next step.
